issues.description: KVirtArea::query models page-table guard ownership with a 'static lifetime even though atomic mode is established only by a local preemption guard.
issues.rationale: The selected head's query contract receives `Guards<'static, KernelPtConfig>` and a `PageTableGuard<'static, KernelPtConfig>`, but the implementation creates `preempt_guard` locally with `disable_preempt()` and only borrows it for the cursor call. The executable guarantee that preemption is disabled therefore ends when this local guard is dropped, while the tracked/ghost lock state is typed as statically available and is not tied to that real borrow. A proof can consequently treat page-table lock capability as outliving the actual atomic-mode interval, invalidating the intended scheduling/locking safety argument. Reviewer comments 4531285586 and 4531408222 identify precisely this lifetime mismatch and call the associated specifications unsound; the author agrees that a caller/user-provided guard lifetime is not truthful and rejects bypassing the issue. The final PR head still has the static tracked parameters, and the PR was closed as superseded by #908 rather than accepting this design.
